---
name: Documentation improvement
about: Report missing, incorrect, unclear, or outdated repository documentation
title: "[DOCS] "
labels: ["documentation", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Documentation location
Provide the file path and section heading, if known.

## Problem
Explain what is missing, incorrect, contradictory, or difficult to follow.

## Current wording or behavior
Quote the relevant text or describe the current instructions. Include a link to the file where possible.

## Expected documentation
Describe the information a contributor or user should be able to understand or complete.

## Implementation status
- [ ] Documentation does not match current code.
- [ ] A required guide is missing.
- [ ] A command or example is incorrect.
- [ ] A local link is broken.
- [ ] A project limitation is not explained.
- [ ] Other.

## Suggested correction
Provide a proposed structure, example, or corrected wording if available.

## Validation
Explain how the revised documentation can be checked against the repository. Do not document planned functionality as if it were implemented.
